description: v6 main PCB probe points for the I2C arms S1 (master end) and S2 (BQ end). Approved picture: lab/procedures/img/v6-probe-points.png.

blocks.text: v6 main board, top side. Hold it with the USB-C socket at the top left.

markers.label: A
markers.legend: S1: SDA probe (CH1) on the round pad marked "SD"

markers.label: B
markers.legend: S1: SCL probe (CH2) on the round pad marked "SC"

markers.label: C
markers.legend: S1: ground, 2nd hole from the left in the lower header row (GND); short wire

blocks.text: S2, zoomed in: the charger chip (U5) and capacitor C21

markers.label: D
markers.legend: S2: SDA probe (CH1) on U5 pin 6, the BOTTOM pin of U5's left side

markers.label: E
markers.legend: S2: SCL probe (CH2) on U5 pin 5, the pin just above D

markers.label: F
markers.legend: S2: ground spring on THIS end of C21 (the end farther from U5)

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: the other end of C21. Never touch, never bridge to F

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: one end of C20. Also keep clear

blocks.text: Rendered from the v6 KiCad layout (commit {commit}). Pin positions are from the layout file, so check under the microscope before probing.
